Research interests

QuantumInformation.Black Holes.Gravity.

Research overview →
01 /

Quantum Information in Quantum Gravity

Exploring multipartite entanglement, its geometric description in holography, and the role of replica symmetry in connecting quantum correlations to spacetime.

Entanglement · Emergent geometry ↗ 02 /

Black Holes and Holography

Studying supersymmetric ground states, black hole phases and instabilities, and their microscopic description through gauge–gravity duality.

Supersymmetry · Black hole thermodynamics ↗

Background

From quantum systems
to spacetime.

I completed my PhD in theoretical physics at the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research, Mumbai, advised by Abhijit Gadde. My thesis focused on multipartite entanglement in holography.

Before TIFR, I studied physics and mathematics at IISER Thiruvananthapuram and spent a research summer at the LIGO Laboratory at Caltech.
